title: Acceptance language characterizes halting acceptance
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic machine over Boolean symbols, let $x$ and $v$ be Boolean lists, and let $s$ be a natural number. Suppose $N$ uses space bounded by a function $sp$ on every input, and $sp(|x|)\le s$. The encoding of $x$, the code of the configuration reached by running $N$ on $x$ using choice string $v$, and the code of the space bound $s$ belongs to the acceptance language of $N$ if and only if that run halts and its output is exactly $[\mathrm{true}]$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic machine $N$ over Boolean symbols
A function $sp$ bounding the space used by $N$ on every input
